name: Bulk Update User Roles
description: Bulk-adds/removes roles across ALL users in one click. SECURITY: the form route requires only 'administer users', but it offers EVERY role (including administrator) and applies them directly (addRole) — bypassing core's rule that role assignment needs 'administer permissions'. So an 'administer users'-only account can grant itself/everyone the admin role (privilege escalation). Restrict to 'administer permissions' and filter to assignable roles.
